setting: Setting: 15th-century Vietnam (Dai Viet), Le dynasty. It must look Vietnamese, NOT Japanese: mandarins wear long round-collared robes and black winged gauze caps; palace halls have red wooden columns, dragon carvings and curved tiled roofs; commoners wear cross-collared tunics and cloth head wraps; banana trees, bamboo, rivers. No kimono, no samurai, no katana. No violence, no blood.

scenes.c1: Night by a wide river: a lychee orchard with clusters of red lychee fruit on dark green trees, a small wooden royal pavilion with one glowing lantern among the trees, a royal dragon boat with a golden canopy moored at the bank, sleeping guards with spears, full moon and mist.
scenes.c3: Inside a Vietnamese royal court at dusk: mandarins in dark robes whispering to each other behind red columns with suspicious, jealous faces, while two guards lead away an honest official who walks with his head held high.
scenes.c4: An elderly Vietnamese scholar with a thin grey beard, black head wrap and plain white tunic sitting peacefully on a flat rock beside a mountain stream under tall pine trees, reading a book, a small thatched hut and misty green mountains behind.
scenes.c5: A Vietnamese throne hall: a very young king of about eighteen in a golden-yellow dragon robe and black winged cap smiling warmly from his throne and reaching out a hand to welcome an elderly scholar-official with a thin grey beard in a dark blue mandarin robe who bows before him.
scenes.c6: A riverside market in old Vietnam: a graceful, clever-looking young woman in a brown tunic and head scarf carrying rolled sedge mats on a shoulder pole, exchanging words with a scholar in a white tunic and black head wrap who holds a paper fan; boats and thatched stalls behind.
scenes.c7: Inside a Vietnamese palace hall: an elegant, intelligent woman in a refined long green and cream court dress with her hair wrapped in a cloth headband, teaching a group of young palace maids who sit on mats with books and writing brushes; red columns, a lotus pond outside.
scenes.c8: A Vietnamese palace corridor: several royal consorts in rich red and purple court dresses watching with jealous, suspicious eyes from behind a carved wooden screen, while in the distance an elegant woman teacher in a green dress walks beside the young king in a golden-yellow robe.
scenes.c10: Night inside a small wooden pavilion in a lychee orchard: a young king in a golden-yellow robe sitting at a low table with a wine cup, a plate of red lychees and a single candle; an elegant woman in a green court dress kneeling at a respectful distance pouring tea; open windows show the moon and lychee trees.
scenes.c12: A somber palace courtyard under a grey sky: a court official in a red robe reading a verdict from an open scroll; before him an elderly scholar with a thin grey beard kneels calmly in plain white clothes with his family kneeling behind him, soldiers with spears standing guard.
scenes.c13: A Vietnamese throne hall: a one-year-old baby king in a tiny golden robe sitting on a huge throne, and behind him, half hidden by a beaded bamboo curtain, his mother the queen regent in a rich red dress watching the bowing mandarins with a cold, calculating face.
scenes.c14: Night at the gate of a small Buddhist temple in the countryside: an elderly scholar with a thin grey beard and an elegant woman in a green dress helping a frightened pregnant young royal consort in a hooded cloak step down from a small boat; a kind old nun holding a lantern welcomes her.
scenes.c15: A legend scene: a scholar with a thin beard reading at a low desk at night by an oil lamp, while a large white snake coils on the roof beam above him and a single red drop falls from it onto the open page of his book. Mysterious mood.
scenes.c16: A wise Vietnamese king of about twenty-five in a golden-yellow dragon robe and black winged cap standing at an open palace window at night, holding a writing brush and a sheet of paper, looking up at one very bright star shining in the dark sky.
scenes.c18: Present day: a peaceful old Vietnamese temple among pine trees on a hillside, with a bronze statue of a scholar with a thin beard holding a book; visitors in modern clothes offering incense, smoke rising, soft morning light.
